t: Natilus - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding
s: Natilus designs, develops, and produces blended-wing-body aircraft for both cargo and passenger use, focusing on new air transport platforms rather than conventional tube-and-wing planes. Its product lines include the KONA freighter series, built for freight operations, and the HORIZON family, built for commercial passenger travel.
